idea-plugin.name: Claude Todos
idea-plugin.description:
Live task list for your Claude Code agents, plus agent tree, per-task progress, tokens/context/cache and a 7-day usage dashboard — read from the transcripts Claude Code already writes. Companion of the Claude Todos VS Code extension.

Claude Code 2.1.233+ turns the task-list tools off by default on the newer models. The plugin offers to turn them on when you open a project; you can also set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 in ~/.claude/settings.json yourself (see the README). The rest of the panel works without it.

实时显示你的 Claude Code 智能体的任务列表，以及智能体树、每个任务的进度、令牌/上下文/缓存， 和 7 天用量面板 —— 全部从 Claude Code 已经写入的对话记录中读取。 Claude Todos VS Code 扩展的配套插件。

Claude Code 2.1.233 起在新模型上默认关闭任务列表工具。插件会在你打开项目时提示一键开启； 你也可以自行在 ~/.claude/settings.json 中设置 CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1（详见 README）。 面板的其余功能不受影响。
